description.value: E.P. Orchards is a certified-organic farm shop on Bentley Road in Naramata, situated in the heart of the Okanagan's fruit-growing country. The operation offers self-harvesting (U-pick), making it a hands-on stop for cyclists exploring the Naramata Bench. It sells exclusively organic produce, a rarity along the route.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website returns only an 'Under Construction' placeholder (54 bytes), so no amenity or contact details can be confirmed from it. OSM tags (shop=farm, organic=only, self_harvesting=yes) establish this as an organic U-pick farm in Naramata and serve as the sole evidence base. All amenity fields default to null except Basic groceries, which is supported by the shop=farm + organic=only OSM tags indicating produce is sold on-site.
concerns: Website returns only an 'Under Construction' placeholder — no amenities, hours, or contact details could be verified from it.
No postal code available in OSM address tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, identifiable organic farm shop in Naramata with OSM presence, phone, and email. Website being under construction does not indicate the business is closed or non-existent.
